$sources: EN 1991-1-1 Sec 6.3.1.2(10) Eq 6.1 (αA) and (11) Eq 6.2 (αn), recommended values

sources.areaAndStoreys: EN 1991-1-1 Eq 6.1: αA = 5/7 ψ0 + A0/A ≤ 1.0, A0 = 10 m², for categories C and D αA ≥ 0.6 (Note 1, recommended); Eq 6.2: αn = (2 + (n - 2) ψ0)/n for more than two storeys of categories A-D; ψ0 = 0.7 (EN 1990 Table A1.1, A-D). SAEngine uses the lesser of the two on a member (the code leaves their joint use to the National Annex)
sources.heavyLive: SAEngine practice: loads above the largest recommended value of categories A-D (5.0 kN/m²) are not reduced
sources.notReduced: EN 1991-1-1 Sec 6.3.1.2(10)-(11) reduce categories A-D only: storage (E) and crowds on stands are not reduced (SAEngine keeps C5 unreduced)
sources.twoFloorsOnly: Categories F and G are not reduced (Sec 6.3.1.2 applies to A-D)
